name: Thumb Radial Collateral Ligament Injury
definition: Injury of the thumb MCP radial collateral ligament causing pain and instability on the radial side of the joint.

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess avulsion; ultrasound/MRI may characterize complete tears.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Thumb-spica support for partial stable injuries
amber: Complete unstable tears may need surgical repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Angushtha-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Injury of the thumb MCP radial collateral ligament causing pain and instability on the radial side of the joint.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
